title: Golden pair binary half (.log.bin) has no digest binding it to its .t1 manifest
evidence:
+# t1 manifest — per-tick FNV-1a-64 state hashes (full sim state)
+t1 1
+demo legacy_decay
+seed 20261
+logic_hz 20
+catalog_hash 733a64aef127178c
+ticks 1400
...
Binary files /dev/null and b/goldens/legacy_decay.log.bin differ
detail: Manifest pins demo, seed, hz, catalog_hash, ticks — but nothing ties each .t1 to its companion .log.bin golden, whose bytes are unreviewable here. Pair integrity is unverified.
recommended_fix: Add a digest field to each t1 header (e.g. log_bin_hash <hex>) computed over the .log.bin, so the harness can verify each golden pair's binary half matches its ledger.
